"""String annotations naming a former-root binding that only TYPE_CHECKING imports."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from threetears.evals import host as evals_host
    from threetears.evals import shapes as evals_shapes


def listed(host: "evals_host.OpsHost", runs: "list[evals_shapes.LaunchArguments] | None" = None) -> "evals_host.OpsHost":
    held: "evals_host.OpsHost | None" = None
    return cast("evals_host.OpsHost", held or host)
